rows.title: My values did nothing

rows.title: Preserve my fixes
rows.summary: The assistant rewrote my app. Are my fixes still there? Then ConfigHub carries the fixes through the rewrite.

rows.title: What my app needs
rows.summary: Will my app run on the platform I picked? Refused for two real reasons, fixed on both sides, then checked.

rows.title: Before GitOps takes over

rows.title: From one chart to a governed fleet in ten minutes

rows.title: Use ConfigHub Workshop with your AI agent
